title: Private Residence | First Independent Project
subtitle: Living, Dining & Bedroom Interiors – Where ADS Creative Space Began
description: The first project Atish Dipankar designed as an independent designer, in 2020. Selected rooms of a 3,200 sq.ft. residence in Gangarampur, with a slatted display partition between the living and dining areas, a textured living room feature wall and three bedrooms with built-in storage and lit niche shelving.
body:
This 2020 residence in Gangarampur was the first project Atish Dipankar took on as an independent designer, and it marks where ADS Creative Space began.

The brief covered selected rooms of a 3,200 sq.ft. home: the living and dining areas and the bedrooms. Instead of a solid wall, a slatted white display partition separates the living and dining spaces while keeping them visually connected. Textured feature walls and lit display niches give each room a focal point.

In the bedrooms, built-in storage was treated as a design element: a full wall of staggered, individually lit niches, full-height two-tone wardrobes and panelled or wallpapered bed walls. Many of the ideas that recur in the studio's later work, such as integrated storage, layered lighting and a single strong feature wall per room, first appear here.
features.0.title: A Partition That Connects
features.0.text: Instead of a solid wall, a white slatted partition with lit display niches separates the living and dining areas while keeping views open between them. The dining area is set under a timber-slat ceiling inset and a sculpted cage pendant.
features.1.title: A Textured Living Room Wall
features.1.text: The sofa wall is clad in a sculpted, fan-pattern textured finish, washed by wall lights from above, with a bold horse artwork as its focal point. Grey sectional seating and a crate-style coffee table keep the room relaxed.
features.2.title: A Wall of Lit Niches
features.2.text: In one bedroom, a full wall of staggered recessed niches, lined in dark wood and individually lit, becomes a bookshelf and a display for collected pieces, so storage turns into the room's main feature.
features.3.title: Built-In Storage & Panelled Bed Walls
features.3.text: Full-height wardrobes in two-tone finishes, panelled bed walls in dark textured laminate and a damask wallpaper panel framed in grasscloth texture give each bedroom its own character within a simple, practical layout.
